read_first: subject/source relationship edge shard when relationship is causal
exact information claim shard plus the holder knowledge shard for claim authorization
exact delivery shard or holder delivery-membership shard when transmission history is causal
write_order: write one exact claim shard and affected holder knowledge shard
write one exact delivery shard plus sender/recipient delivery-membership routes when knowledge moves
update the bounded information routing/count projection
write relationship edge only if the interaction mechanically changes relationship
invariants: Affiliation is not automatically a personal relationship.
World truth is not automatically knowledge.
Knowledge requires an explicit information path and recipient.
Relationship feeling, factual knowledge, and public reputation are separate authorities.
